STRIPE_INTEGRATION.TITLE: Stripe
STRIPE_INTEGRATION.DESCRIPTION: View customer details, subscriptions, and invoices alongside your conversations.
STRIPE_INTEGRATION.DISCONNECT_NOTE: Disconnecting removes the saved credentials from Chatwoot. Uninstall the app in Stripe to revoke its access there.
STRIPE_INTEGRATION.ERROR: Unable to load Stripe. Please try again or reconnect the integration.
STRIPE_INTEGRATION.EMPTY: No Stripe customer matches this contact's email.
STRIPE_INTEGRATION.NO_EMAIL: Add an email to this contact to look up Stripe customers.
STRIPE_INTEGRATION.MORE: Showing the first 100 matching customers. Refine the contact email if the customer is not listed.
STRIPE_INTEGRATION.CANCELS_AT_PERIOD_END: Cancels at the end of the billing period
STRIPE_INTEGRATION.MORE_ITEMS: Additional subscription items are not shown.
STRIPE_INTEGRATION.PRICE_NOTE: Prices are per unit, before discounts and taxes. They are not an estimate of the next invoice.
